quote: indicated for the treatment of recurrent herpes labialis (cold sores) in adults
note: Recurrent herpes labialis is recurrent oral herpes.

quote: indicated for the relief of symptoms of depression. Endogenous depression is more likely to be alleviated than other depressive states.
note: Endogenous depression is a named subtype of indicated depression.

quote: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema
note: Chronic bronchitis is explicitly included in the COPD indication.
Back pain not mentioned; only endometriosis-associated pain and contraception.

quote: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue valsartan and hydrochlorothiazide tablets as soon as possible
note: Indicated for hypertension generally; pregnancy appears only in fetal-toxicity warnings.

quote: Diabetic Macular Edema (DME)
note: DME is a listed indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure
note: Malignant hypertension is a subtype of indicated hypertension.

quote: indicated for the treatment of hypertension, alone or with other antihypertensive agents, to lower blood pressure
note: Secondary hypertension is a subtype of indicated hypertension.
Nephrotic syndrome not mentioned; label covers hyperlipidemia/CV risk.

quote: indicated for the management of moderate to severe pain associated with endometriosis
note: Management of disease pain counts as treating endometriosis.

quote: correction of hemodynamic imbalances present in the shock syndrome
note: Shock syndrome is the treated condition.

quote: treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma
note: Plasma cell myeloma = multiple myeloma.

quote: Treatment of adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis
note: RA is a listed indication.

quote: Reduce the risk of non-fatal myocardial infarction and stroke.
note: Stroke prevention is an indication.

quote: Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura in adults Secondary thrombocytopenia in adults
note: Thrombocytopenia forms are listed hematologic indications.

quote: Dermatographism
note: Dermatographism is listed; familial form is a subtype.

quote: treatment of edema associated with heart failure, renal disease or hepatic disease
note: Label treats edema; renal disease is the underlying cause.

note: Angina pectoris is an indication.
Pelvic pain not mentioned in any section.

quote: in the treatment of infections of the eye caused by susceptible strains of P. aeruginosa
note: Eye infections are indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE)
note: Lower-limb DVT is a subtype of indicated DVT.

quote: for treatment of primary dysmenorrhea
note: Primary dysmenorrhea is a listed indication.

quote: Oral Olanzapine and fluoxetine in combination is indicated for the treatment of treatment resistant depression
note: TRD indicated (combination therapy).

quote: Torisel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with advanced renal-cell carcinoma (RCC)
note: EMA indication for RCC.

quote: Baricitinib is indicated for the treatment of active juvenile idiopathic arthritis in patients 2 years of age and older
note: EMA indication for JIA.

quote: seasonal allergic rhinitis
note: Seasonal allergic rhinitis is a listed indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adult patients
note: gMG indicated.

quote: Efficacy has been shown in a PAH population including aetiologies of idiopathic or heritable PAH
note: Idiopathic PAH is within the indicated PAH population.

note: Malignant essential hypertension is a severe form of indicated essential hypertension.

quote: congenital (erythroid) hypoplastic anemia (Diamond Blackfan anemia), pure red cell aplasia
note: Erythroid hypoplastic anemia is a listed hematologic indication.

Limb pain not mentioned; label covers acute painful musculoskeletal conditions generally.
Hernia pain not mentioned; label covers ulcers, GERD, hypersecretory states.
Neonates not mentioned; PAH indicated only in adults and pediatric patients 1 to 17 years.

quote: Avoid using aspirin in patients with a history of active peptic ulcer disease
note: Ulcer appears only in contraindications/warnings.

note: Label covers H. pylori infection only; "Infection" is a whole class.

quote: previously untreated Stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL)

quote: indicated for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in adults who have a mutation in the superoxide dismutase 1
